scripts.build:runtime: npm --global=false run build -w friday-agent-core && npm --global=false run build -w friday-agent-harness
scripts.build:cli: npm run build:runtime && npm --global=false run build -w friday-agent-cli && bun scripts/build-cli.mjs
scripts.check: npm --global=false run build -w friday-agent-core && npm --global=false run check -w friday-agent-harness && npm --global=false run typecheck -w friday-agent-cli
scripts.desktop:ts: npm run build:runtime && npm run desktop:ts --prefix ui-desktop
scripts.bundle:desktop:ts: npm run sidecar:ts && npm run bundle:ts --prefix ui-desktop
scripts.pack:release: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('artifacts/npm',{recursive:true})" && npm pack --pack-destination artifacts/npm && npm pack -w friday-agent-core --pack-destination artifacts/npm
scripts.test: npm --global=false run test -w friday-agent-core && npm --global=false run test -w friday-agent-harness && npm --global=false run test -w friday-agent-cli
